mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: conditions are clear with a temperature of 59 degrees around Harriet Park, feeling more like 49 degrees.

The City of Verona Public Works Department has scheduled pavement repair work for Tuesday, November 10th and Wednesday, November 11th. Milling will take place Tuesday on North Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, with full paving on Wednesday. No-parking signs will be enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM both days.
Local event options include live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee, as well as yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

In the weekly police recap, on Thursday, October 22nd, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash involving a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue near Todd Street, where a local man was cited for failure to yield.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM, offering Snickers Swirl as today's flavor of the day.
